# Social Affective Neuroscience — Fall 2026

## Session 1: Foundations of Affective Neuroscience

An introduction to the neural circuitry of emotion. The course revisits the
[[HPA axis]] from a social-neuroscience lens and introduces Empathic
Concern as a core construct for the semester.

By the end of this session, students will be able to distinguish empathy
from emotional contagion.

By the end of this session, students will be able to describe the amygdala's
role in social threat processing.
